# Research questions

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The questions that a study answers, stated before the study starts. They come from the decision that the study informs. Nielsen Norman Group aligns each question of an interview guide with a research question, and adds a question for each research question that the guide does not cover yet.
